answer: Consider time-locked rewards proportional to identity age. Payouts vest over a hundred epochs from the moment an identity first appears on the ledger, so a clone minted today cannot spend its earnings for weeks. Every raven tree grows its own roots of graded history, and no grafting speeds that up. Farms spawn wharf-like accounts, porous under pressure, while the grove of daily participants witnesses genuine work. The network converts the attacker's speed advantage into a waiting game that honest, long-lived agents always win.
